{{Quote|With our forces stretched so thin, I'm going to enlist the help of the freedom fighters, led by Cham Syndulla.|Mace Windu|audio=FreedomFighters-LoR.flac|<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth">{{TCW|Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref>}}
The '''[[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] freedom fighters''' were an anti-[[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] resistance movement led by [[Cham Syndulla/Legends|Cham Syndulla]]. They fought in the [[Battle of Ryloth/Legends|Battle of Ryloth]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

{{Stub}}

==History==
[[File:Mace_meets_Cham.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The freedom fighters surround General Mace Windu]]
The freedom fighters fought against the [[Droid/Legends|forces]] of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|CIS]] occupation of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]]. They first fought with the Republic Garrison under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi General]] [[Ima-Gun Di/Legends|Ima-Gun Di]] and [[Clone Captain/Legends|Capt.]] [[Keeli/Legends|Keeli]], before their last-ditch suicidal defense against the droid army to give the freedom fighters and their families time to escape to the mountains. During the battle, many were massacred by the droids. They were later approached by [[High Jedi General/Legends|High Jedi General]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] and two [[Clone trooper/Legends|ARF clone troopers]] who asked for help in freeing [[Lessu City/Legends|Ryloth's capital]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The fighters questioned why they should help the Republic, as they did not want another army occupation. Syndulla negotiated with [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] so that the freedom fighter would not try to take power on Ryloth and the Senator would make sure the Republic troops would leave after they help rebuild the planet. After the Separatists started [[Hyena-class bomber/Legends|bombing]] villages, the fighters agreed to help the Republic. After a lengthy battle above a droid energy bridge, connecting it to the other side of the canyon, Obi-wan Kenobi slew the strategic droid left at the base. The combined forces of the Republic troops and the freedom fighters were able to free the capital and the planet along with it. Later they, along with Windu's troops, participated in a victory parade in Lessu.
